  simp [witnessHom, b, evalWitness, bp]

name: two_b_ne_zero
statement: theorem two_b_ne_zero : (2 : R) * b ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply two_bw_ne_zero
  simpa [map_ofNat] using congr_arg witnessHom h

name: VB_relation
statement: @[simp] theorem VB_relation : VB ^ 2 = algebraMap R B (a ^ 2) * VB
proof:
:= by
  simp [pow_two, QuadraticAlgebra.omega_mul_omega_eq_algebraMap]

name: U_relation
statement:
@[simp] theorem U_relation :
    U ^ 2 = algebraMap R A (a * b) * U - algebraMap R A (b ^ 2) * V
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_two]
  unfold U V
  rw [QuadraticAlgebra.omega_mul_omega_eq_mk]
  ext <;> simp [VB, aB, bB, pow_two, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R B A]

name: V_relation
statement: @[simp] theorem V_relation : V ^ 2 = algebraMap R A (a ^ 2) * V
proof:
:= by
  change (algebraMap B A VB) ^ 2 = algebraMap R A (a ^ 2) * algebraMap B A VB
  rw [← map_pow, VB_relation, map_mul, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R B A]

name: finrank_B
statement: theorem finrank_B : Module.finrank R B = 2
proof:
:=
  QuadraticAlgebra.finrank_eq_two _ _

name: finrank_A_over_B
statement: theorem finrank_A_over_B : Module.finrank B A = 2
proof:
:=
  QuadraticAlgebra.finrank_eq_two _ _

name: finrank_A
statement: theorem finrank_A : Module.finrank R A = 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Module.finrank_mul_finrank R B A, finrank_B, finrank_A_over_B]

name: mkAlgHomB_VB
statement:
theorem mkAlgHomB_VB (v : S) (hv : v ^ 2 = algebraMap R S (a ^ 2) * v) :
    mkAlgHomB v hv VB = v
proof:
:=
  quadratic_lift_omega v _

name: mkAlgHom_U
statement:
theorem mkAlgHom_U {u v : S} (hv : v ^ 2 = algebraMap R S (a ^ 2) * v)
    (hu : u ^ 2 = algebraMap R S (a * b) * u - algebraMap R S (b ^ 2) * v) :
    mkAlgHom u v hv hu U = u
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra B S := (mkAlgHomB v hv).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  exact quadratic_lift_omega u _

name: mkAlgHom_V
statement:
theorem mkAlgHom_V {u v : S} (hv : v ^ 2 = algebraMap R S (a ^ 2) * v)
    (hu : u ^ 2 = algebraMap R S (a * b) * u - algebraMap R S (b ^ 2) * v) :
    mkAlgHom u v hv hu V = v
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra B S := (mkAlgHomB v hv).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  exact ((QuadraticAlgebra.lift _ : A →ₐ[B] S).commutes VB).trans (mkAlgHomB_VB v hv)

name: law_relations_generic
statement:
private theorem law_relations_generic {S : Type*} [CommRing S]
    {a b u₁ v₁ u₂ v₂ : S}
    (ha : a ^ 3 = 0) (hb : b ^ 3 = 0) (hab : a ^ 2 * b + 2 = 0)
    (hv₁ : v₁ ^ 2 = a ^ 2 * v₁) (hu₁ : u₁ ^ 2 = a * b * u₁ - b ^ 2 * v₁)
    (hv₂ : v₂ ^ 2 = a ^ 2 * v₂) (hu₂ : u₂ ^ 2 = a * b * u₂ - b ^ 2 * v₂) :
    let l₁
proof:
:= (1 + a * u₁) * (1 + b * v₁)
    let l₂ := (1 + a * u₂) * (1 + b * v₂)
    let dv := v₁ * l₂ + v₂
    let du := u₁ + l₁ * u₂
    dv ^ 2 = a ^ 2 * dv ∧ du ^ 2 = a * b * du - b ^ 2 * dv := by
  grind

name: law_lambda_generic
statement:
private theorem law_lambda_generic {S : Type*} [CommRing S]
    {a b u₁ v₁ u₂ v₂ : S}
    (ha : a ^ 3 = 0) (hb : b ^ 3 = 0) (hab : a ^ 2 * b + 2 = 0)
    (hv₁ : v₁ ^ 2 = a ^ 2 * v₁)
    (hv₂ : v₂ ^ 2 = a ^ 2 * v₂) (hu₂ : u₂ ^ 2 = a * b * u₂ - b ^ 2 * v₂) :
    letI l₁
proof:
:= (1 + a * u₁) * (1 + b * v₁)
    letI l₂ := (1 + a * u₂) * (1 + b * v₂)
    letI dv := v₁ * l₂ + v₂
    letI du := u₁ + l₁ * u₂
    (1 + a * du) * (1 + b * dv) = l₁ * l₂ := by
  grind

name: mapped_relations
statement:
private theorem mapped_relations {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (f : A →ₐ[R] S) :
    letI aa
proof:
:= f aA
    letI bb := f bA
    letI uu := f U
    letI vv := f V
    aa ^ 3 = 0 ∧ bb ^ 3 = 0 ∧ aa ^ 2 * bb + 2 = 0 ∧
      vv ^ 2 = aa ^ 2 * vv ∧ uu ^ 2 = aa * bb * uu - bb ^ 2 * vv := by
  split_ands
  · simp [aA, ← map_pow, a_cube]
  · simp [bA, ← map_pow, b_cube]
  · rw [← map_ofNat f]
    suffices f (aA ^ 2 * bA + 2) = 0 by simpa
    suffices aA ^ 2 * bA + 2 = 0 by simp [this]
    suffices algebraMap R A (a ^ 2 * b + 2) = 0 by simpa [aA, bA, -base_relation]
    simp
  · rw [← map_pow, V_relation, map_mul]
    simp [aA, ← map_pow]
  · have h : U ^ 2 = aA * bA * U - bA ^ 2 * V := by
      simp [aA, bA, map_pow, map_mul]
    simpa only [map_pow, map_sub, map_mul] using congr_arg f h

name: right_aA
statement: private theorem right_aA : right aA = a₁
proof:
:= by
  change (1 : A) ⊗ₜ[R] aA = aA ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : A)
  rw [show aA = a • (1 : A) from Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one a]
  exact (TensorProduct.tmul_smul a 1 1).trans (TensorProduct.smul_tmul' a 1 1).symm

name: right_bA
statement: private theorem right_bA : right bA = b₁
proof:
:= by
  change (1 : A) ⊗ₜ[R] bA = bA ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : A)
  rw [show bA = b • (1 : A) from Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one b]
  exact (TensorProduct.tmul_smul b 1 1).trans (TensorProduct.smul_tmul' b 1 1).symm

name: delta_relations
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha₁, hb₁, hab₁, hv₁', hu₁'⟩ := mapped_relations (S := A ⊗[R] A) left
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hv₂', hu₂'⟩ := mapped_relations (S := A ⊗[R] A) right
  simp only [right_aA, right_bA] at hv₂' hu₂'
  exact law_relations_generic ha₁ hb₁ hab₁ hv₁' hu₁' hv₂' hu₂'

name: delta_lambda
statement:
private theorem delta_lambda :
    (1 + a₁ * deltaU) * (1 + b₁ * deltaV) = l₁ * l₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha₁, hb₁, hab₁, hv₁', -⟩ := mapped_relations (S := A ⊗[R] A) left
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hv₂', hu₂'⟩ := mapped_relations (S := A ⊗[R] A) right
  simp only [right_aA, right_bA] at hv₂' hu₂'
  exact law_lambda_generic ha₁ hb₁ hab₁ hv₁' hv₂' hu₂'

name: a
statement: private theorem a₁_smul : a₁ = a • 1
proof:
:= by
  change (aA ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : A)) = a • 1
  rw [show aA = a • (1 : A) from Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one a]
  exact TensorProduct.smul_tmul' a 1 1

name: b
statement: private theorem b₁_smul : b₁ = b • 1
proof:
:= by
  change (bA ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : A)) = b • 1
  rw [show bA = b • (1 : A) from Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one b]
  exact TensorProduct.smul_tmul' b 1 1

name: comul_U
statement: theorem comul_U : comul U = deltaU
proof: := mkAlgHom_U _ _

name: comul_V
statement: theorem comul_V : comul V = deltaV
proof: := mkAlgHom_V _ _

name: comul_aA
statement: theorem comul_aA : comul aA = a₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [comul.commutes, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, ← a₁_smul]

name: comul_bA
statement: theorem comul_bA : comul bA = b₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [comul.commutes, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, ← b₁_smul]

name: left_lambda
statement: theorem left_lambda : left lambda = l₁
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lambda, map_mul, map_add, map_one]

name: right_lambda
statement: theorem right_lambda : right lambda = l₂
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lambda, map_mul, map_add, map_one, right_aA, right_bA]

name: comul_lambda
statement: @[simp] theorem comul_lambda : comul lambda = left lambda * right lambda
proof:
:= by
  rw [left_lambda, right_lambda]
  simpa [lambda, map_mul, map_add, comul_aA, comul_bA, comul_U, comul_V] using delta_lambda

name: comul_U_formula
statement:
@[simp] theorem comul_U_formula :
    comul U = left U + left lambda * right U
proof:
:= by
  rw [comul_U, left_lambda]
  rfl

name: comul_V_formula
statement:
@[simp] theorem comul_V_formula :
    comul V = left V * right lambda + right V
proof:
:= by
  rw [comul_V, right_lambda]
  rfl

name: algHom_ext
statement:
theorem algHom_ext {S : Type*} [Semiring S] [Algebra R S]
    {f g : A →ₐ[R] S} (hU : f U = g U) (hv : f V = g V) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  have h_embed (z : B) :
      algebraMap B A z = algebraMap R A z.re + algebraMap R A z.im * V := by
    have hz : z = algebraMap R B z.re + algebraMap R B z.im * VB := by
      calc
        z = ⟨z.re, z.im⟩ := rfl
        _ = algebraMap R B z.re + z.im • VB :=
          QuadraticAlgebra.mk_eq_add_smul_omega z.re z.im
        _ = algebraMap R B z.re + algebraMap R B z.im * VB := by
          apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;> simp [VB]
    calc
      algebraMap B A z = algebraMap B A
          (algebraMap R B z.re + algebraMap R B z.im * VB) := congr_arg _ hz
      _ = algebraMap R A z.re + algebraMap R A z.im * V := by
        rw [map_add, map_mul, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R B A,
          ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R B A]
  have hB (z : B) : f (algebraMap B A z) = g (algebraMap B A z) := by
    rw [h_embed]
    simp only [map_add, map_mul]
    rw [f.commutes, f.commutes, g.commutes, g.commutes, hv]
  have hx : x = algebraMap B A x.re + algebraMap B A x.im * U := by
    apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;> simp [U]
  rw [hx, map_add, map_mul, map_add, map_mul, hB x.re, hB x.im, hU]

name: counit_V
statement: @[simp] theorem counit_V : counit V = 0
proof: := mkAlgHom_V _ _

name: counit_U
statement: @[simp] theorem counit_U : counit U = 0
proof: := mkAlgHom_U _ _

name: counit_lambda
statement: @[simp] theorem counit_lambda : counit lambda = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [lambda]

name: comul_coassoc
statement:
theorem comul_coassoc :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc R R R A A A).toAlgHom.comp
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map comul (.id R A)).comp comul) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id R A) comul).comp comul
proof:
:= by
  apply algHom_ext
  · simp [comul_U_formula, comul_lambda, Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def,
      TensorProduct.add_tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_add, add_assoc]
  · simp [comul_V_formula, comul_lambda, Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def,
      TensorProduct.add_tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_add, add_assoc]

name: counit_left
statement:
theorem counit_left :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map counit (.id R A)).comp comul =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.lid R A).symm
proof:
:= by
  apply algHom_ext
  · simp [counit_lambda]
  · simp

name: counit_right
statement:
theorem counit_right :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id R A) counit).comp comul =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.rid R R A).symm
proof:
:= by
  apply algHom_ext
  · simp
  · simp [counit_lambda]

name: bialgebra_comulAlgHom
statement: private theorem bialgebra_comulAlgHom : Bialgebra.comulAlgHom R A = comul
proof: := rfl

name: bialgebra_counitAlgHom
statement: private theorem bialgebra_counitAlgHom : Bialgebra.counitAlgHom R A = counit
proof: := rfl

name: isGroupLikeElem_lambda
statement:
theorem isGroupLikeElem_lambda : IsGroupLikeElem R lambda where
  counit_eq_one
proof:
:= by
    rw [← Bialgebra.counitAlgHom_apply (R := R), bialgebra_counitAlgHom]
    exact counit_lambda
  comul_eq_tmul_self := by
    rw [← Bialgebra.comulAlgHom_apply (R := R), bialgebra_comulAlgHom, comul_lambda]
    simp

name: theta_identities_generic
statement:
private theorem theta_identities_generic {S : Type*} [CommRing S]
    {aa bb uu vv : S}
    (ha : aa ^ 3 = 0) (hb : bb ^ 3 = 0) (hab : aa ^ 2 * bb + 2 = 0)
    (hv : vv ^ 2 = aa ^ 2 * vv)
    (hu : uu ^ 2 = aa * bb * uu - bb ^ 2 * vv) :
    letI th
proof:
:= (1 + aa * uu) * (1 + bb * vv) - 1

name: theta_sq

proof:
:= by

name: powerMap_succ_U
statement:
theorem powerMap_succ_U (n : ℕ) :
    powerMap (n + 1) U = powerMap n U + powerMap n lambda * U
proof:
:= by
  change (universalPoint ^ (n + 1)).ofConv U = _
  rw [pow_succ universalPoint n, AlgHom.convMul_apply, ← Bialgebra.comulAlgHom_apply,
    bialgebra_comulAlgHom, comul_U_formula]
  simp [universalPoint, powerMap]

name: four_eq_zero
statement: theorem four_eq_zero : (4 : A) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha, _, hab, _, _⟩ := mapped_relations (AlgHom.id R A)
  change aA ^ 3 = 0 at ha
  change aA ^ 2 * bA + 2 = 0 at hab
  linear_combination -(aA ^ 2 * bA - 2) * hab + aA * bA ^ 2 * ha

name: lambda_eq_one_add_theta
statement: theorem lambda_eq_one_add_theta : lambda = 1 + theta
proof:
:= by

  ring

name: lambda_pow_four
statement: theorem lambda_pow_four : lambda ^ 4 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have ht (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) : theta ^ k = 0 := pow_eq_zero_of_le hk theta_sq
  rw [lambda_eq_one_add_theta]
  linear_combination theta * four_eq_zero + 6 * theta_sq + 4 * ht 3 (by norm_num) +
    ht 4 (by norm_num)

name: powerMap_lambda
statement: theorem powerMap_lambda (n : ℕ) : powerMap n lambda = lambda ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [powerMap_zero_apply, counit_lambda]
  | succ n ih => rw [powerMap_succ_lambda, ih, pow_succ lambda n]

name: powerMap_U
statement: theorem powerMap_U (n : ℕ) : powerMap n U = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, lambda ^ i) * U
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [powerMap_zero_apply, counit_U]
  | succ n ih => rw [powerMap_succ_U, ih, powerMap_lambda, geom_sum_succ']; ring

name: powerMap_V
statement: theorem powerMap_V (n : ℕ) : powerMap n V = V * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, lambda ^ i
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [powerMap_zero_apply, counit_V]
  | succ n ih => rw [powerMap_succ_V, ih, geom_sum_succ]; ring

name: geom_sum_four
statement: theorem geom_sum_four : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 4, lambda ^ i = 2 * bA * V
proof:
:= by
  have ht (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) : theta ^ k = 0 := pow_eq_zero_of_le hk theta_sq
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add, lambda_eq_one_add_theta]
  linear_combination two_theta + (1 + theta) * four_eq_zero + 4 * theta_sq + ht 3 (by norm_num)

name: powerMap_four_U
statement: theorem powerMap_four_U : powerMap 4 U = 2 * bA * U * V
proof:
:= by
  rw [powerMap_U, geom_sum_four]
  ring

name: two_b_U_V_ne_zero
statement: theorem two_b_U_V_ne_zero : 2 * bA * U * V ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hOuter := congr_arg (fun x : A ↦ x.im) h
  have hInner := congr_arg (fun x : B ↦ x.im) hOuter
  apply two_b_ne_zero
  simpa [bA, U, V, VB, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R B A] using hInner

name: powerMap_four_U_ne_zero
statement: theorem powerMap_four_U_ne_zero : powerMap 4 U ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [powerMap_four_U]
  exact two_b_U_V_ne_zero

name: powerMap_four_V
statement: theorem powerMap_four_V : powerMap 4 V = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [powerMap_V, geom_sum_four]
  have hv : V ^ 2 = aA ^ 2 * V := by
    simp [aA, map_pow]
  have hab : aA ^ 2 * bA + 2 = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨_, _, hab, _, _⟩ := mapped_relations (AlgHom.id R A)
    simpa using hab
  rw [show V * (2 * bA * V) = 2 * bA * V ^ 2 by ring, hv]
  linear_combination 2 * V * hab - V * four_eq_zero

name: geom_sum_eight
statement: theorem geom_sum_eight : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 8, lambda ^ i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have ht (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) : theta ^ k = 0 := pow_eq_zero_of_le hk theta_sq
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add, lambda_eq_one_add_theta]
  linear_combination (2 + 7 * theta) * four_eq_zero + 56 * theta_sq +
    70 * ht 3 (by norm_num) + 56 * ht 4 (by norm_num) + 28 * ht 5 (by norm_num) +
    8 * ht 6 (by norm_num) + ht 7 (by norm_num)

name: powerMap_eight_U

name: powerMap_eight_V

name: powerMap_eight

name: antipode_right_identity
statement:
theorem antipode_right_identity :
    ((Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (powerMap 7) (.id R A) fun _ ↦ Commute.all _).comp
      (Bialgebra.comulAlgHom R A)) =
        (Algebra.ofId R A).comp (Bialgebra.counitAlgHom R A)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congr_arg WithConv.ofConv powerMap_seven_mul_universalPoint
  change
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' R).comp
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map (powerMap 7) (.id R A)).comp
          (Bialgebra.comulAlgHom R A)) =
      (Algebra.ofId R A).comp (Bialgebra.counitAlgHom R A) at h
  rw [← AlgHom.comp_assoc, Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul'_comp_map] at h
  exact h

name: antipode_left_identity
statement:
theorem antipode_left_identity :
    ((Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (.id R A) (powerMap 7) fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _).comp
      (Bialgebra.comulAlgHom R A)) =
        (Algebra.ofId R A).comp (Bialgebra.counitAlgHom R A)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congr_arg WithConv.ofConv universalPoint_mul_powerMap_seven
  change
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' R).comp
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id R A) (powerMap 7)).comp
          (Bialgebra.comulAlgHom R A)) =
      (Algebra.ofId R A).comp (Bialgebra.counitAlgHom R A) at h
  rw [← AlgHom.comp_assoc, Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul'_comp_map] at h
  exact h

name: exists_hopfAlgebra_not_killed_by_finrank
statement:
theorem exists_hopfAlgebra_not_killed_by_finrank :
    ∃ (S : Type) (_ : CommRing S) (_ : Nontrivial S) (H : Type) (_ : CommRing H)
      (_ : HopfAlgebra S H) (_ : Module.Free S H) (_ : Module.Finite S H),
        0 < Module.finrank S H ∧
          WithConv.toConv (AlgHom.id S H) ^ Module.finrank S H ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨R, inferInstance, inferInstance, A, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    inferInstance, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [finrank_A]; norm_num
  · rw [finrank_A]
    have h8 : orderOf (WithConv.toConv (AlgHom.id R A)) = 8 := orderOf_universalPoint
    exact pow_ne_one_of_lt_orderOf (by norm_num) (by rw [h8]; norm_num)

name: not_isCocomm
statement: theorem not_isCocomm : ¬Coalgebra.IsCocomm R A
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hU := DFunLike.congr_fun h.comm_comp_comul U
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply,
    ← Bialgebra.comulAlgHom_apply (R := R), bialgebra_comulAlgHom] at hU
  rw [comul_U_formula] at hU
  simp only [map_add, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, one_mul,
    mul_one, TensorProduct.comm_tmul] at hU
  have h2 := congr_arg (fun z ↦ TensorProduct.lid R R (TensorProduct.map coeffU coeffV z)) hU
  have hV1 : coeffV 1 = 0 := rfl
  have hVU : coeffV U = 0 := rfl
  have hU1 : coeffU 1 = 0 := rfl
  have hUU : coeffU U = 1 := rfl
  have hVlam : coeffV lambda = b := by
    change lambda.re.im = b
    simp [lambda, aA, bA, U, V, VB, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R B A]
  simp only [map_add, TensorProduct.map_tmul, TensorProduct.lid_tmul, hV1, hVU, hVlam, hU1,
    hUU, smul_eq_mul, one_mul, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add] at h2
  exact two_b_ne_zero (by rw [h2, mul_zero])

name: id_pow_op_unop_hom

        simp only [pow_succ, Hom.mul_def, unop_comp, CommAlgCat.hom_comp,
          CommAlgCat.mul_op_of_unop_hom, CommAlgCat.lift_unop_hom, unop_id, CommAlgCat.hom_id,
          ih]
      rw [h, ← Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul'_comp_map, AlgHom.comp_assoc]
      rfl

name: exists_lt_notMem_of_disjoint
statement:
private lemma exists_lt_notMem_of_disjoint {U V : Set (Iic ω₁)} (hV : V ∈ 𝓝 ⊤)
    (hUV : Disjoint U V) (x : Iio ω₁) : ∃ y, x < y ∧ inc y ∉ U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcV⟩ := nhds_top_basis.mem_iff.mp hV
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hz'⟩ := (Cardinal.isSuccLimit_omega 1).lt_iff_exists_lt.mp
    (max_lt x.2 (Subtype.coe_lt_coe.mpr hc))
  have hcz : c < inc ⟨z, hz⟩ := Subtype.coe_lt_coe.mp ((le_max_right _ _).trans_lt hz')
  exact ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, Subtype.coe_lt_coe.mp ((le_max_left _ _).trans_lt hz'),
    disjoint_right.mp hUV (hcV hcz)⟩

name: not_normalSpace_Iio_prod_Iic_omega_one
statement:
theorem not_normalSpace_Iio_prod_Iic_omega_one :
    ¬ NormalSpace (Iio.{u+1} ω₁ × Iic.{u+1} ω₁)
proof:
:= by
  intro
  let A : Set (Iio ω₁ × Iic ω₁) := {(a,b) | inc a = b}
  let B : Set (Iio ω₁ × Iic ω₁) := {(a,b) | b = ⊤}
  have hA : IsClosed A := isClosed_eq (inc_embedding.continuous.comp continuous_fst) continuous_snd
  have hB : IsClosed B := isClosed_eq continuous_snd continuous_const
  have hAB : Disjoint A B := by
    rw [disjoint_left]
    intro ⟨a, b⟩ (ha : inc a = b) (hb : b = ⊤)
    exact absurd (Subtype.ext_iff.mp (ha.trans hb)) a.2.ne
  obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV, hAU, hBV, hUV⟩ := normal_separation hA hB hAB
  choose β hβ1 hβ2 using fun x => exists_lt_notMem_of_disjoint
    ((hV.preimage (.prodMk_right x)).mem_nhds (hBV rfl)) (hUV.preimage _) x
  let seq : ℕ → Iio ω₁ := Nat.rec ⟨0, (Cardinal.isSuccLimit_omega _).bot_lt⟩ fun _ ↦ β
  have hmono : Monotone (fun n => (seq n).1) :=
    monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun n => (Subtype.coe_lt_coe.mpr (hβ1 (seq n))).le
  have hbω₁ : ⨆ i, (seq i).1 < ω₁ := Ordinal.iSup_lt_omega_one fun n ↦ (seq n).2
  have htf : Tendsto (fun n => (seq n).1) atTop (𝓝 (⨆ i, (seq i).1)) :=
    tendsto_atTop_ciSup hmono ⟨ω₁, mem_upperBounds.mpr <| forall_mem_range.mpr fun n ↦ (seq n).2.le⟩
  have htprod : Tendsto (fun n => ((seq n, inc (seq (n + 1))) : Iio ω₁ × Iic ω₁))
      atTop (𝓝 (⟨_, hbω₁⟩, inc ⟨_, hbω₁⟩)) :=
    (IsInducing.subtypeVal.tendsto_nhds_iff.mpr htf).prodMk_nhds
      (IsInducing.subtypeVal.tendsto_nhds_iff.mpr
        (htf.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)))
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (htprod.eventually (hU.mem_nhds (hAU rfl))).exists
  exact hβ2 (seq n) hn

name: not_normalSpace_shrink_Iio_prod_Iic_omega_one

    ¬ NormalSpace (Shrink.{u} (Iio ω₁ × Iic ω₁))

statement:
theorem subspace_of_paracompact_not_paracompact :
    ¬ ∀ (X : Type u) (Y : Type v) [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : X → Y),
      ParacompactSpace Y → IsEmbedding f → ParacompactSpace X
proof:
:= fun h ↦

name: product_of_normal_not_normal

    ¬ ∀ (X : Type u) (Y : Type v) [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y],
      NormalSpace X → NormalSpace Y → NormalSpace (X × Y)
proof:

  let _ := h (Shrink.{u} (Iio ω₁)) (Shrink.{v} (Iic ω₁)) inferInstance inferInstance
  not_normalSpace_Iio_prod_Iic_omega_one
    ((Shrink.homeomorph _).symm.prodCongr (Shrink.homeomorph _).symm).normalSpace

name: subspace_of_normal_not_normal
statement:
theorem subspace_of_normal_not_normal :
    ¬ ∀ (X : Type u) (Y : Type v) [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : X → Y),
      NormalSpace Y → IsEmbedding f → NormalSpace X
proof:

    h _ _ _ inferInstance isEmbedding_shrink_prodMap_inc_id

name: regular_not_normal

proof:

name: grading.mul_mem
statement:
theorem grading.mul_mem :
    ∀ ⦃i j : Two⦄ {a b : R × R} (_ : a ∈ grading R i) (_ : b ∈ grading R j),
      a * b ∈ grading R (i + j)
  | 0, 0, a, b, (ha : a.1 = a.2), (hb : b.1 = b.2) => show a.1 * b.1 = a.2 * b.2 by rw [ha, hb]
  | 0, 1, a, b, (_ : a.1 = a.2), (hb : b.1 = 0) =>
    show a.1 * b.1 = 0 by rw [hb, mul_zero]
  | 1, 0, a, b, (ha : a.1 = 0), _ => show a.1 * b.1 = 0 by rw [ha, zero_mul]
  | 1, 1, a, b, (ha : a.1 = 0), _ => show a.1 * b.1 = 0 by rw [ha, zero_mul]

end

name: eq_one

proof:

  apply ciInf_le_of_le bddBelow_range_add ((0, 1) : ℝ × ℝ); dsimp [q1, q2]

name: not_distrib
statement: theorem not_distrib : ¬(p ⊔ q1) ⊓ (p ⊔ q2) ≤ p ⊔ q1 ⊓ q2
proof:
:= by
  intro le_sup_inf
  have c : ¬4 / 3 ≤ (1 : ℝ) := by norm_num
  apply c; nth_rw 1 [← eq_one]
  apply le_trans _ (le_sup_inf _)
  apply le_ciInf; intro x
  rcases le_or_gt x.fst (1 / 3) with h1 | h1
  · rcases le_or_gt x.snd (2 / 3) with h2 | h2
    · calc
        4 / 3 = 4 * (1 - 2 / 3) := by norm_num
        _ ≤ 4 * (1 - x.snd) := by gcongr
        _ ≤ 4 * |1 - x.snd| := by gcongr; apply le_abs_self
        _ = q2 ((1, 1) - x) := rfl
        _ ≤ (p ⊔ q2) ((1, 1) - x) := le_sup_right
        _ ≤ (p ⊔ q1) x + (p ⊔ q2) ((1, 1) - x) := le_add_of_nonneg_left (apply_nonneg _ _)
    · calc
        4 / 3 = 2 / 3 + (1 - 1 / 3) := by norm_num
        _ ≤ x.snd + (1 - x.fst) := by gcongr
        _ ≤ |x.snd| + |1 - x.fst| := add_le_add (le_abs_self _) (le_abs_self _)
        _ ≤ p x + p ((1, 1) - x) := add_le_add le_sup_right le_sup_left
        _ ≤ (p ⊔ q1) x + (p ⊔ q2) ((1, 1) - x) := add_le_add le_sup_left le_sup_left
  · calc
      4 / 3 = 4 * (1 / 3) := by norm_num
      _ ≤ 4 * x.fst := by gcongr
      _ ≤ 4 * |x.fst| := by gcongr; apply le_abs_self
      _ = q1 x := rfl
      _ ≤ (p ⊔ q1) x := le_sup_right
      _ ≤ (p ⊔ q1) x + (p ⊔ q2) ((1, 1) - x) := le_add_of_nonneg_right (apply_nonneg _ _)

name: SqZeroExtQuotMax.not_exists_linearEquiv_ideal_of_invertible
statement:
theorem SqZeroExtQuotMax.not_exists_linearEquiv_ideal_of_invertible [Nontrivial (Pic R)] :
    ∃ M : Pic (SqZeroExtQuotMax R),
    ¬ ∃ I : Ideal (SqZeroExtQuotMax R), Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[SqZeroExtQuotMax R] I)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  have ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_ne (1 : Pic R)
  have ⟨I, ⟨eI⟩⟩ := h (M.mapAlgebra R _)
  have ⟨J, ⟨eJ⟩⟩ := h (M⁻¹.mapAlgebra R _)
  have := Module.Invertible.congr eI
  have := Module.Invertible.congr eJ
  obtain ⟨rfl | rfl⟩ := I.eq_top_of_mk_tensor_eq_one J <| by
    rw [Pic.mk_tensor, ← Pic.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨eI⟩, ← Pic.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ⟨eJ⟩,
      Pic.mk_eq_self, Pic.mk_eq_self, ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel, map_one]
  have eq := Pic.mk_eq_one_iff.mpr ⟨eI ≪≫ₗ Submodule.topEquiv⟩
  rw [Pic.mk_eq_self] at eq
  let := TrivSqZeroExt.algebraBase
  have eq := congr(Pic.mapAlgebra (SqZeroExtQuotMax R) R $eq)
  exact hM <| by rwa [map_one, Pic.mapAlgebra_mapAlgebra, Pic.mapAlgebra_self] at eq
